limitations: The 01-04 filename code is represented as biological replicate because the public record says four U2OS replicates, but individual culture identifiers are not supplied. Age, sex and tibia refer to the U2OS parent-line donor in Cellosaurus, not the cultures' current age or tissue.

The PARG factor is perfectly confounded with the two filename date-code groups (all ctrl/mock 20250220; all PARG 20250303). The codes may reflect acquisition dates or batches, but their meaning is unverified and they are retained literally.
The PARG versus mock factor is a post-lysis treatment of captured PARP1, not a cell treatment.
Four repeated modification columns are inserted deterministically after the builder, which otherwise retains only the last modification row from the technical table.
